Hi everyone! 

We're non-married, I'm non-israeli, my partner is the Israeli one. We  applied online (Herzlyia branch) and recieved an answer this morning. In the email, they give my boyfriend a date to go hand in the documents on September 6th. He's suppose to be out of the country on that date. We know we're lucky they got back to us fairly quickly, we're just trying to see if he can avoid cancelling a whole trip and losing a bunch of money...

1) From your experience, can we ask them for a different date, and how long after could they give us a new date? If we ask to postpone his appointment, do we take the risk to get new one only in 2 months?

2) if we decided to ask for a new date, do we have better chances if asked answering their email, or by showing up on Sunday?

Thanks a lot :)
